digest.component_or_area: dependency management and pip-audit CI gate
propositions: A committed lock file freezes transitive dependencies, causing any newly-published advisory against a pinned version to trigger gating pip-audit failures across all in-flight changes regardless of code involvement.
An upstream capping dependency (e.g. inspect-ai capping click) can hold the entire project on a vulnerable version due to uv's universal resolution locking all extras jointly.

override-dependencies (workspace-only directive) is the correct mechanism to override a stale upstream cap; constraint-dependencies cannot resolve this case and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected behavior.
uv lock --upgrade-package against an upstream cap is a no-op and cannot lift the pinned version constraint.
The pip-audit job's retry logic only handles DB-unreachable transient failures, not real findings, so real advisory discoveries cannot be rechecked without code changes.
Stale overrides (via --ignore-vuln) lack a detection mechanism and can persist silently past their REMOVE-WHEN justification condition.
